authority: Maintainer: lets do that, get us closer to thought to text. Implements only the proposed bounded probability-readout investigation on already-authorized development calibration data under standing Tier B; fresh data acquisition and prospective recording remain separately scoped.
target: Five-word development labels; all 600 original trials, three people, both conditions. Repeatedly explored calibration cohort, not independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Training-only scalar confidence calibration improves the proper probability score of unchanged word predictors; separately test whether a joint EEG increment survives equally calibrated auxiliary and misalignment controls. Accuracy/log-loss divergence motivates this hypothesis but does not establish it.
features: Exactly N392, A692 and auxiliary-independent full_all EEG768 from speech_time_frequency_plan.v0.json. Reuse unchanged streaming time_frequency extraction, discard other views without fitting. No NLMS or auxiliary statistics in EEG preprocessing. Full-window filtering and normalization remain noncausal.
base_model: Unchanged one-hot ridge alpha1 with unpenalized intercept, separate train-only feature-block standardization and sqrt(dimension) scaling; original softmax output retained. No change to representation, ridge strength, seed, word choice, participants or trials.
arms: Each of nine learned arms has its original output and a _calibrated output; uniform and training_prior are unchanged. Twenty arms total, both outer schemes and both conditions retained.
outer_splits: Exactly preceding blocked_embargo1 primary and stratified_shuffled secondary: five folds, original trial as indivisible unit, original seed20260921, original split hashes. All repetitions stay together. Retrospective within-recording, not past-to-future.
inner_blocked: For each outer training set, intersect it with each remaining original20-trial validation block. Four nonempty inner folds; exclude from inner training the original-index immediate neighbors of the inner validation rows. Every outer-training row gets exactly one inner held-out prediction. Never use outer validation or outer embargo rows.
inner_random: KFold4 shuffleTrue random_state20260922+100*scheme_index+outer_fold on outer-training rows, independent of labels; same folds for all arms. No inner stratification on true labels that could contaminate shuffled controls.
inner_preprocessing: Fit centering/scaling separately on each inner training set. Refit on the full outer training set only after calibrator fitting; no outer-validation statistic or label enters any fit.
temperature: p_calibrated=softmax(beta*log(p_original)), beta=1/T. Fit one scalar per arm and outer fold using pooled inner OOF class-macro log loss computed by stable unclipped log-softmax, preserving convexity. Final historical scoring retains its1e-15 probability floor; report how many true-class probabilities fall below it. Fixed beta interval[0.05,20],60 derivative-bisection steps with explicit boundary handling. Report beta,T,boundary status and inner scores; no grid or outer-score selection. Positive temperature must preserve argmax on every outer row.
label_shuffle: One original outer-training permutation at seed20260921+100*scheme_index+outer_fold, shared by all shuffled arms. Use those permuted labels consistently for inner ridge fitting, pooled temperature fitting and outer ridge refit. Never calibrate a shuffled arm on true labels.
derangement: One-position cyclic EEG row shift independently within every actual inner or outer training and validation partition; auxiliaries aligned; scaling precedes shift. No cross-partition donor. Diagnostic, not a calibrated permutation test.
preflight: Before any fit, all six recordings must pass outer and inner original-index disjointness, full inner coverage, blocked embargo and training class support checks for both true and shuffled labels. On failure stop the whole invocation; no split repairs or exclusions.
primary_metric: Class-macro log loss pooled over100 original outer-OOF trials per person. Equal-person descriptive mean. Balanced accuracy is a secondary invariance check, not an endpoint replacement.
conditional_threshold: Joint calibrated log loss strictly lower than all six equally treated comparators in all three people within each condition under blocked validation. Descriptive consistency, not statistical significance; report all participant gains and random-split sensitivity.
readout_diagnosis: Report original-minus-calibrated log-loss gains for every arm; positive means improvement. Consistent improvement of both A and A_full_all in all three people within a condition supports a confidence-scale limitation of these readouts on development data; lack of consistency rejects that simple all-person account. Calibration cannot add signal or improve argmax accuracy.

interpretation.calibration_only: Better probability estimation, not improved word choices, new neural information, or thought-to-text.
interpretation.conditional_pass: Exploratory conditional predictive association after fair probability calibration; a candidate for fresh-context confirmation, never a reversal of earlier frozen results.
interpretation.conditional_fail: Probability scaling did not establish a consistent EEG increment; stop this branch without further temperature ranges, objectives, features or score rescues.
interpretation.covert_fail: No supported general imagined-word capability on this cohort; minimally overt success cannot substitute for covert evidence.
interpretation.boundaries: Boundary fits and participant heterogeneity are retained; do not expand the range after observing results. All meaningful outcomes require fresh confirmation.

stop_rule: One invocation after generated tests and both remote CI jobs pass. Preserve failures, no automatic retry or partial result. Scientific code unchanged throughout. No waveform/feature cache; private OOF outputs local only. Five previous scientific aggregates remain byte-identical.

claim_coordinates.attribution: conditional predictive association, not cortical origin

method_reference: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/guo17a.html; positive temperature calibration is established prior art, not a novel algorithm.
